citation.authors: Hamasaki A, Harada N, Muraoka A, et al.
citation.title: The integrated incretin effect is reduced by both glucose intolerance and obesity in Japanese subjects

population.description: Fourteen Japanese subjects with normal glucose tolerance (3 women, 11 men; Table 1), classified by the Japan Diabetes Society criteria from a 75 g OGTT. That classification is the screening: the paper gives no recruitment route and no other health or medication information. Age and BMI are the NGT group's printed mean +/- SD; no observed range is printed. Only the NGT group is entered; the IGT and T2D groups are not.

protocols.name: fasting_sample
protocols.description: Fasting sample of the NGT group after an overnight fast, before the 75 g OGTT; no meal; a 30-minute run-in stands for the single sample (Table 1 does not say when the fasting value was drawn; OGTT samples were at -15 and 0 min)

findings.description: Fasting immunoreactive insulin (serum, two-site radioimmunoassay), NGT group
Fasting plasma glucagon (radioimmunoassay, Millipore), NGT group

left_out.what: AUC of glucose and of insulin during the OGTT, NGT group (Table 2, rows 'OGTT'): the samples are printed (-15, 0, 10, 20, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180 min) but the paper does not say which of them the AUC spans (from -15 or from 0, to 180), and Table 2 gives no window

glucagon change in AUC from baseline, 0-180 and 0-60 min, during the OGTT, NGT group (Table 3): printed in min·nM, which is not a glucagon unit the model reads and would be a mean fall of several nM against a fasting glucagon of 28 pM in Table 1; the baseline value is not defined (first sample or mean of the -15 and 0 min samples)

AUC of total GIP and of total GLP-1 during the OGTT, NGT group (Table 3, printed in min·nM): as for glucose and insulin, the paper does not say which of the printed samples the AUC spans (from -15 or from 0, to 180 min)
AUC of active GIP and of active GLP-1 during the OGTT, NGT group (Table 3): the model's gip and glp1 are the total hormones
AUC of C-peptide during the OGTT, NGT group (Table 2)
AUC of glucose, insulin, C-peptide, GIP, GLP-1 and glucagon during the isoglycemic intravenous infusion (IIGI), NGT group (Tables 2 and 3): the arm cannot be written, see the infusion entry below
numerical incretin effect (insulin and C-peptide) and GIGD, a function of two arms' incremental AUCs or of infused glucose (Table 2)
isoglycemic IV glucose infusion arm: the infusion rate profile that reproduced each OGTT glucose curve is only in Figure 1J-L (total infused grams are in Table 2)
IGT and T2D groups (Tables 1-3): type 2 diabetes cannot be stated; IGT is a glucose-tolerance class the model cannot be told
glucose, insulin, C-peptide, GIP, GLP-1 and glucagon time courses (Figures 1, 3, 5)
HOMA-IR and insulinogenic index, computed from the 0 and 30 min OGTT values (Table 1)
correlations with BMI, AUC-glucose and GIGD pooled over all 28 subjects of the NGT, IGT and T2D groups (Results text)
